Who sits within the business development function but is responsible for the first 3 stages of the sales cycle. Your focus is to identify, develop, and create new enterprise business opportunities in new accounts for Account Executives in specific territories in the APAC region, working with 60 of the largest Australian enterprise companies.

result.description:
We are looking for a curious and analytically driven Data Scientist to join our team and transform complex datasets into actionable insights that inform strategic decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of mathematics, statistics, programming, and business intelligence, requiring a candidate who can build and deploy sophisticated analytical frameworks including machine learning and AI solutions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver with strong communication skills, capable of translating data-driven findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Collect, prepare, and clean large datasets for analysis, identifying and resolving data anomalies, inconsistencies, and quality issues to ensure analytical integrity
Apply advanced analytical techniques drawing on mathematical, statistical, programming, and database skills to extract meaningful insights from structured and unstructured data
Design, build, and deploy machine learning and artificial intelligence frameworks that support automation, prediction, and pattern recognition across business functions
Develop, evaluate, and iteratively refine statistical models and algorithms to uncover trends, forecast outcomes, and generate actionable insights
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and translate them into clearly defined data science problems and analytical solutions
Present data-driven findings, visualisations, and recommendations to key decision-makers and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner
Contribute strategic input and innovation to the organisation's data science roadmap, identifying opportunities to leverage data for competitive advantage
Maintain and document data pipelines, modelling processes, and analytical methodologies to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing across the team
Monitor and assess the performance of deployed models, implementing updates and improvements as required to maintain accuracy and relevance
Support data governance and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organisational data management policies
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience in a data science or advanced analytics role, with a portfolio of applied projects
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, with experience in data manipulation libraries (e.g. pandas, NumPy) and machine learning frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
Experience working with large datasets and familiarity with SQL and database querying
Ability to develop and evaluate predictive models, performing validation, tuning, and performance assessment
Proficiency in data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent libraries (e.g. Matplotlib, Seaborn)
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate complex findings into clear, business-relevant insights
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting to non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

result.description:
Duties and Responsibilities:
As a IT Consultant/Programmer, you will be responsible for analysing, assessing, designing, developing, testing, implementing maintaining and supporting quality applications that supports the company’s key objectives.

Main responsibilities include:
• Writing software code, automated unit tests, and debugging the code to delivery documented working software that meets the requirements in accordance to FedEx secure code practices, policies and established coding standards.
• Translate business requirements and system requirements into detailed technical specifications or business features and user stories using the SAFe Agile framework.
Provide technical mentoring and guidance to other developers.
• Design application solutions that meet complex business requirements, modelling the solution and implement code reviews and other quality management practices across a team of developers.
• Implement software development design patterns to deliver on complex technical requirements to deliver well-engineered working software that is scalable, resilient, maintainable, performant, secure, fault-tolerant, portable, extensible, reusable, testable and easy to use.
• Design and execute complex application testing for functional and non-functional testing including stress and load testing, building test doubles/hubs, test management data, regression testing and complex scenario and use case management.

Analyst and Support Tasks:
• Consultation and analysis of key systems with Stakeholder.
• Collaborating with the enterprise Applications Team and Operations Team around production incidents involving integration to directly or indirectly ensure their timely resolution/recovery and preventative measures are taken to avoid recurrence and minimize business impact
• Maintenance of operational and end-user documentation
• Planning and technical delivery of integration work packages

Experience and Qualifications:
• Minimum 2+ years experience using Java JMS API in a Linux/Unix environment.
• Experience in developing Java applications in Cloud Native environment.
• Experience in building microservices using Spring Core and Spring Cloud.
• Extensive knowledge and experience in using Microservices Architecture Patterns.
• Experience in TDD and BDD practices using Java & Spring based Junit & BDD frameworks.
• Good knowledge and experience in using Kafka for message streaming and for event driven pub/sub notifications.
• Experience in modern networking, IPV4 stack, ICMP, UDP, TCP/IP, socket programming.
• Experience with working with databases e.g. MSSQL, MYSQL, Informix, Oracle.
• Proven ability to lead the development of software development projects.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or similar
SAFe Agile certification highly desirable
result.title: IT Consultant / Programmer
